title: Invariance of the single-complex comparison under nested source-open restriction
statement: Let f:X→S, f′:X′→S′, g:S′→S and g′:X′→X form a commutative square of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. Let K∈D(O_X), K′∈D(O_{X′}) and φ:L(g′)*K→K′ [def-pc-derived-category, def-pc-derived-pullback]. For open subschemes Z⊆W⊆X, put P=X′×_X W with projections p:P→X′ and q:P→W, f_W=f|W, f′_W=p composed with f′, K_W=L(W→X)*K, and K′_W=Lp*K′. Define φ_W:Lq*K_W→K′_W by the canonical pullback composition comparison Lq*L(W→X)*K≅L(q composed with W→X)*K=L(p composed with g′)*K≅Lp*L(g′)*K followed by Lp*φ [lem-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-pullback-composition]. The ambient comparison b_Z [def-pc-single-complex-open-comparison] is invertible if and only if the comparison on the open (W→X)⁻¹Z computed in the restricted square (q,f′_W,f_W,g) with coefficient arrow φ_W is invertible. No cartesianness, quasi-coherence, compactness, affine-base, cover or local-isomorphism hypothesis is imposed.

proof.text: Put A = W⁻¹(Z) inside W. Since Z ⊆ W, the composite A → W → X has image Z. Its canonical image isomorphism identifies A with Z over X. Pasting the pullback squares and uniqueness of their limits identifies (X′ ×_X W) ×_W A with X′ ×_X Z compatibly with both projections. These are isomorphisms of the two restricted commutative squares.

Use the canonical derived pullback composition comparisons on A → W → X and on the two pullback projections to X′. The associative composition law and naturality with φ identify the twice-restricted coefficient arrow with the once-restricted arrow after those source isomorphisms. The coefficient is the explicit composite of the pullback comparison, equality transport from the pullback condition, inverse pullback comparison, and pullback of φ; no object or arrow is obtained from a bare existence theorem.

Take the mates of these pullback composition comparisons under the canonical derived adjunctions to identify the direct-image functors. To check the base-change arrows, transpose under the target adjunction as in the counit definition of the base-change map. Both transposes are the pullback composition identification followed by pullback of the source counit. Naturality of the counit and the associative law give equality; injectivity of the adjunction Hom equivalence gives equality of the comparison arrows after the identifications. Here the isomorphisms are e:A≅Z and e′:((X′×_X W)×_W A)≅(X′×_X Z). Their structural maps to S and S′ agree after composition with e and e′, so their pinned adjunction units and counits are invertible. Apply the cited mate-pasting computation to these coordinate isomorphisms. No unit or counit for the open immersion W→X is asserted invertible. The pulled-back φ is compatible by its naturality in the preceding step.

The two arrows are therefore conjugate by isomorphisms in D(O_{S′}). A composite with invertible arrows is invertible if and only if the middle arrow is invertible. Apply this in both directions. The construction includes empty Z, empty W, Z = W and W = X, since it uses only pullback and adjunction identities.

theorem singleComplexOpenComparison_nested_isIso_iff
    [∀ Y : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    {X X' S S' : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ S) (f' : X' ⟶ S') (g : S' ⟶ S) (g' : X' ⟶ X)
    (h : g' ≫ f = f' ≫ g)
    (K : schemeDerivedCategory X) (K' : schemeDerivedCategory X')
    (φ : (derivedPullback g').obj K ⟶ K')
    (W Z : X.Opens) (hZW : Z ≤ W) :
    let hW : pullback.snd g' W.ι ≫ (W.ι ≫ f) =
        (pullback.fst g' W.ι ≫ f') ≫ g := by
      rw [← pullback.condition_assoc, Category.assoc, h, ← Category.assoc]
    let φW : (derivedPullback (pullback.snd g' W.ι)).obj
        ((derivedPullback W.ι).obj K) ⟶
        (derivedPullback (pullback.fst g' W.ι)).obj K' :=
    (((Classical.choose (Classical.choose_spec (Classical.choose_spec
      (Classical.choose_spec exists_derivedPullbackComposition))))
      (pullback.snd g' W.ι) W.ι).hom.app K ≫
    eqToHom (congrArg (fun k ↦ (derivedPullback k).obj K)
      (pullback.condition (f := g') (g := W.ι)).symm) ≫
    ((Classical.choose (Classical.choose_spec (Classical.choose_spec
      (Classical.choose_spec exists_derivedPullbackComposition))))
      (pullback.fst g' W.ι) g').inv.app K ≫
    (derivedPullback (pullback.fst g' W.ι)).map φ)
    IsIso (singleComplexOpenComparison f f' g g' h K K' φ Z) ↔
      IsIso (singleComplexOpenComparison (W.ι ≫ f) (pullback.fst g' W.ι ≫ f')
        g (pullback.snd g' W.ι) hW ((derivedPullback W.ι).obj K)
        ((derivedPullback (pullback.fst g' W.ι)).obj K') φW (W.ι ⁻¹ᵁ Z))
